# Exploration

This chapter will develop exploratory analysis of the prepared NYPD 311 data.
Planned topics include distributions, group and time comparisons, missingness,
unusual observations, and the distinction between exploratory patterns and
confirmatory evidence. Visualization techniques are developed in the next
chapter. The analysis will revisit the four formulation checks in
@sec-formulation-checks: domain fit motivates which patterns warrant attention,
measurement and scope fit constrain their interpretation, and evidence fit
distinguishes exploratory patterns from confirmatory claims.
